name: noticed-leaked-temp-file

finding.title: The temporary file is left in the user's directory when the write fails
finding.description: When `tmp.Write` fails, the function returns without removing the temp file, so a `main.tf-fmt123456` file stays next to the user's config. The failure this change guards against, a write error such as a full disk or `ulimit -f`, is exactly what takes this branch, so every such run leaves another stray file in the user's directory.
finding.suggestedFix: Remove the temp file on every error path after a successful `CreateTemp`, for example with a deferred `os.Remove` guarded by a `renamed` flag.
